messages:
nora-docs: Heads-up I opened a PR to clarify APAC region availability and update the HK/SG SDK examples. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012

jin-sdk: on it. Which examples are wrong? IIRC our Python wrapper sets region via `client.set_region()` not headers directly.

nora-docs: The current page shows an HTTP header `Region-Code: hk` in the curl and JS samples. That is stale. We should show the Python SDK helper, and for curl show the canonical `X-Redwood-Region` header. Also need to add a short note about network egress for HK customers.

pete-legal: quick legal note: avoid saying "no cross-border transfer". Use: "We route data to regional hosts where possible; customers requiring strict residency should enable Data Residency to enforce regional-only processing."

sam-ux: UX nit: avoid long parenthetical details in the top paragraph. Suggest a small inline link to the residency FAQ instead.

jin-sdk: pushing suggested snippet replacement. New examples: 

```python
# SDK helper example (preferred)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['RW_KEY'])
client.set_region('hk', residency='strict')
resp = client.generate('Summarize the meeting notes')
```

And curl canonical header example: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: hk" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input": "Hello"}'
```

jin-sdk: Also added a small migration blurb: "Deprecated header `Region-Code` will be supported during a transition period; please migrate to `X-Redwood-Region` or SDK helpers."

nora-docs: added Pete's legal phrasing and Sam's link suggestion. Moved the detailed network egress note to a collapsible FAQ at the bottom.

ci-bot: linkcheck queued. docs-lint failed: MD013 line length on residency.md line 102.

jin-sdk: fixing the long line now, will wrap the curl example and reflow text.

nora-docs: one more request: can we surface the known capacity caveat for HK during local holiday bursts? small callout: "Regional capacity may be limited during local public holidays; set `residency=best_effort` to allow fallback to nearest region."

pete-legal: that phrasing is fine, but replace `best_effort` with the official enum value `fallback_allowed` (we agreed that earlier).

jin-sdk: updated to `fallback_allowed`. Pushed commits. PTAL. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1012/files#diff-7

doc-bot: PR #1012 by nora-docs  docs/regions/apac-residency.md updated (4 files changed). CI: docs-lint, linkcheck queued.

ci-bot: docs-lint passed. linkcheck found one broken anchor to /docs/residency-faq#edge-cases.

nora-docs: thanks  fixed the anchor and added a redirect in the FAQ.

pete-legal: LGTM for legal. Small nit: include the DPA link in the footnote.

nora-docs: added DPA link and timestamped the footnote.

sam-ux: Approved from UX, copy looks cleaner.

jin-sdk: Approved, will open a follow-up in the SDK repo to add `set_region()` to the public examples.
